requiredBehavior: Either supported backends discharge the branchless-select requirement, or the toolchain names select in the unresolved-obligation diagnostic, or the contract documents select as unavailable on the experiment path. Silent all-cases-met UNKNOWN must go.
summary: Any select() in a function executed via mncs experiment run resolves every case correctly yet reports suite UNKNOWN ('compilation retained required unresolved obligations'): the frontend attaches a realization-branchless machine-intent requirement no backend discharges, and the experiment contract counts it required. mncs.test's own assertions use select pervasively, so the framework idiom and the experiment contract disagree.
title: select() attaches an undischarged machine-intent requirement, turning green experiment suites UNKNOWN
